fusions.name: Drop From the Perch
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Drops onto it for 18 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Raking Talons
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge to Ledge
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, and your dodge chance rises by 15%.

fusions.name: Midflight Twist
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
